    • getMassPercent

      public double getMassPercent()
      Return the normalized ideal-additive-volume mass yield for this range.

      This is 100 * M_range / M_total, where each implied mass term is Delta V_i * SG_i. It is a basis conversion over the caller-supplied TBP and SG60/60 table, not a density-temperature or volume-contraction model.

      Returns:
      normalized mass yield in percent

    • getSpecificGravityWeightedLiquidVolumePercent

      public double getSpecificGravityWeightedLiquidVolumePercent()
      Return the SG60/60-weighted liquid-volume percentage.

      This value is sum(Delta V_i * SG_i) with Delta V_i in liquid-volume percent. It is an auditable ideal-additive-volume bookkeeping term, not a physical mass percentage.

      Returns:
      SG-weighted liquid-volume percentage

    • getLiquidVolumeWeightedBoilingPointKelvinPercent

      public double getLiquidVolumeWeightedBoilingPointKelvinPercent()
      Return the liquid-volume-weighted first boiling-temperature moment.

      This value is sum(Delta V_i * Tbar_i) with Delta V_i in liquid-volume percent and Tbar_i in K. Under the table's piecewise-linear cumulative-recovery assumption, each overlap has Tbar_i = (T_lower,i + T_upper,i) / 2.

      Returns:
      boiling-temperature moment in K liquid-volume percent

    • getLiquidVolumeWeightedSquaredBoilingPointKelvinSquaredPercent

      public double getLiquidVolumeWeightedSquaredBoilingPointKelvinSquaredPercent()
      Return the liquid-volume-weighted second raw boiling-temperature moment.
      Returns:
      second raw boiling-temperature moment in K squared liquid-volume percent
